description: Before writing a feature, list the Lintsure checks it is most likely to run into, with what each looks for and how to avoid it. Use when the user describes something to build ('add a file upload', 'a login page with Supabase', 'a chat with Claude'). Word matching, not a code review: it reads only the description. Returns text; read-only.

feature.description: The feature in plain words, for example "users upload a profile picture that we store in Supabase".

name: plan_checks
